target.artifactTransfer: vagrant upload (WinRM); the topology has no synced folder

vscode.installMode: portable archive expanded to C:\vscode (headless, no interactive installer)

lbabus.note: the cleanroom golden box ships the pinned coordination CLI on PATH, so the extension's CLI-backed commands (showCapabilities/pollBus/postNote) have their prerequisite satisfied on the VM

node.note: no external Node.js on the golden box; @vscode/test-electron (which needs Node) is therefore not run in-VM, so a headless in-VM activation render is not asserted here

activationSignal.goldenVmInstall: PROVEN -- code --list-extensions --show-versions resolves labview-community-ci-cd.labview-benchmark-actor@0.1.0 and the extension package.json is unpacked under the VM's .vscode/extensions

deterministic.activation: activate() registers the 4 commands (showCapabilities, pollBus, postNote, openViewer) and deactivate() is clean -- host-independent, no display required
deterministic.prerequisiteRemediation: invoking a CLI-backed command with the lbabus prerequisite absent surfaces the remediation guidance via showErrorMessage ('lbabus failed: ... Install the coordination CLI')

activationSignal.remainingMaintainerSliver: an interactive real-desktop activation render inside the VM is not asserted here: code.cmd detaches the Electron child on a headless WinRM session-0 (exit 0, no test-host run) and @vscode/test-electron needs Node (absent on the golden box). This mirrors LBA-REQ-004's interactive-render sliver and requires a real desktop session.
